t007: New leads go straight to the right agent, instantly.

t020: A client writes at night and nobody sees it. In Alexandria the lead is held and released automatically when your service hours start again.
t022: Two agents reply to the same client, or nobody does. Here every lead has an owner, and each agent only sees their own.
t024: Without a pipeline, nobody knows who's out on a showing, who has an offer on the table, or who has gone quiet. The pipeline shows it all on one screen.

t079: You connect your WhatsApp, add your agents and watch the leads roll in. To ask questions, get pricing and get started, chat with Mi.IA on WhatsApp.
t082: Do I need to install anything?
t083: No. Alexandria runs in your browser, on a computer or a phone.
t085: Two plans per agency: Alexandria Leads at R$ 299 per month (up to 10 agents) and Alexandria + Mi.IA at R$ 499 per month (also up to 10 agents), with Mi.IA talking to the lead before the agent does. Each plan includes up to 10 active agents; inactive agents don't count and there's no limit on them. Need more active agents? Each extra active agent costs R$ 30 per month on Alexandria Leads and R$ 50 per month on Alexandria + Mi.IA. The 7-day trial unlocks everything. Pay by Pix, boleto or card, through Asaas, with no lock-in contract.
t087: Your agency's. You connect it by scanning a QR code, and you can disconnect whenever you like.
t088: Does every agent see all the leads?
t089: No. Each agent only sees their own leads. The master and the manager see everything.
t090: What if a lead arrives in the middle of the night?
t091: It depends on the plan. On Alexandria Leads, the lead is held and released to your team when service hours begin. On Alexandria + Mi.IA, Mi.IA talks to the client right away, during the hours you choose, and hands them to an agent when your team is back.
t092: Can I bring my own contact list?
t093: Yes. You import a CSV spreadsheet with name, phone and email.
